# The userspaces each desktop package lane builds and install-tests, one per
# line: ARCH|DISTRO|IMAGE|DEBIAN_REVISION (dist/ci/run-package-job.sh's
# arguments). Images are multi-architecture indexes pinned by digest, except
# Arch Linux ARM, whose images are single-architecture: menci's declares an
# amd64 OCI config around an ARM rootfs (for the x86/QEMU fallback), so native
# arm64 runners take gomasy's arm64-declared image.

arm64|arch|docker.io/gomasy/archlinuxarm@sha256:2b73dc79eaf9b816d0e41345258766ac3cb6bb2b407125d9f5b31cf94e177488|

*|debian-13|docker.io/library/debian@sha256:f324c7ff54321e8d9c588493a20244965938ce0aa50bbd1022d38010e9ffc4b1|1+deb13
